title: Audio Models
summary: This module provides a comprehensive suite of models for audio processing, including speech recognition, translation, speaker verification, and protein structure prediction.

nodes.label: Speech Recognition
nodes.title: Speech Recognition Models
nodes.description: Models designed for converting spoken language into text, including CTC-based approaches and pre-training.

nodes.label: Speech Translation
nodes.title: Speech Translation Models
nodes.description: Models handling various speech and text translation tasks, such as speech-to-speech, speech-to-text, and text-to-speech.

nodes.label: Speaker Verification
nodes.title: Speaker Verification Models
nodes.description: Models for extracting X-vectors from audio, used to identify or verify speakers based on their voice characteristics.

nodes.label: Protein Modeling
nodes.title: Protein Structure and Text Models
nodes.description: Models for predicting protein 3D structures from sequences and processing protein-related text.

nodes.label: Audio Frame Classification
nodes.title: Audio Frame Classification Models
nodes.description: Models for classifying individual audio frames, useful for tasks like sound event detection.

nodes.label: Conditional Generation
nodes.title: Conditional Generation Models
nodes.description: Models for real-time conditional generation, supporting streaming audio input and efficient caching.

groups.label: Speech Processing
groups.title: Core Speech Processing
groups.description: Models focused on understanding, translating, and generating human speech.

groups.label: Biological Modeling
groups.title: Biological Sequence Modeling
groups.description: Models dedicated to understanding and predicting biological structures and related text.
